title: Iran Intensifies Attacks on Vessels Transiting Strait of Hormuz
detail: Iran has escalated attacks on vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, threatening recovery in Persian Gulf oil export flows. The intensified interdiction campaign raises concerns about sustained disruption to global oil supply chains dependent on the strategic waterway.

title: CENTCOM: 19 Million Barrels Shipped Through Strait of Hormuz, Refuting Iran's Control Claims
detail: US Central Command (CENTCOM) stated that 19 million barrels of oil have been successfully shipped through the Strait of Hormuz, directly refuting Iranian claims of effective control over the waterway. The data underscores continued international passage despite Iran's interdiction campaign.

title: Iran Targets US-UAE Oil Transfer Vessels Near Strait of Hormuz
detail: Iran's IRGC Navy has begun targeting US-UAE oil transfer vessels operating near the Strait of Hormuz, escalating interdiction efforts against bypass shipping that routes around Iranian controls. The move signals a new phase of pressure on alternative trade corridors as Iran attempts to enforce its blockade strategy.
